How Long Do Home Interiors Take?

What decides how long your project takes, and how to keep it on schedule.

Home / Guides / How Long Do Home Interiors Take?

By the Manzil Homes design team · Visakhapatnam

Every project is different, so timelines depend on scope and decisions. Here is what shapes the schedule and how to avoid delays.

What decides the timeline

  • Scope: a modular kitchen is quicker than a full home
  • Decision speed: design and material approvals
  • Civil work: breaking walls, re-plumbing or re-tiling
  • Material lead times for special finishes or imported items
  • Site access and society rules on working hours
  • Festivals and the monsoon, which affect labour and drying times

The typical sequence

  1. Design and 3D approvals
  2. Drawings, BOQ and material selection
  3. Civil, electrical and plumbing work
  4. False ceiling
  5. Joinery production and installation
  6. Painting, finishing and cleaning
  7. Handover

How to stay on schedule

  • Finalise designs and materials before execution starts
  • Avoid design changes once production begins
  • Be available for key milestone reviews
  • Choose a team that plans with milestones

At Manzil Homes, we agree a milestone-based schedule with you at the start and keep you updated at each stage.

Frequently Asked Questions

What causes the most delays?

Late decisions and design changes after production has started.

Can you work to a move-in date?

Yes. Tell us your date at the start and we will plan the schedule around it.

Do you share a schedule?

Yes. Every project follows a milestone-based schedule.
